_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: 16-digit numeric string, unique across the database

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

app.description: Application context of the document: Auto = automotive caliper MES, Gamp = pharmaceutical GMP, Common = reference data shared by both

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mast_site.name

name.description: Display name of the message type

description.description: What the message carries and when it is sent

unsNamespace.description: UNS namespace of the message; sent in lower case as the application property ns

messageTypeCode.description: Message type within the namespace, sent as the application property msgType

payloadSchemaName.description: Payload schema name carried in the envelope field schema

payloadSchemaVersion.description: Major version of the payload schema

hierarchyLevel.description: ISA-95 level of the node the message describes

senderType.description: Kind of IoT Hub identity that sends the message

targetCollectionName.description: MES collection the ingestion service writes; null when the MES does not store the message

twinPropertyPath.description: Device twin property that holds the current state; null for events

ingestedByMes.description: True when the MES ingestion service stores the message

routedToDataLake.description: True when IoT Hub routing writes the message to the client data lake

status.description: Primary lifecycle state of the document

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1
